item.title: Former CENTCOM Commander's Candid Take On The Situation In The Strait Of Hormuz
item.description: Retired Army General Joseph Votel offers unique insights into what it will take to wrestle the Strait of Hormuz from Iran's clutches.

item.title: F-22 Raptor "2.0" Spotted Undergoing Flight Testing
